snippet.title: Tape Of The Ghouls 2 No Commentary
snippet.description:
Welcome !! I post videos playing various video games, 
with no commentary or talking. Just a pure gaming experience. 
Be sure to subscribe to get the latest videos and join the community. 

Thanks for watching!
Game Link- https://fredrichi.itch.io/tape-of-the-ghouls-2

Creator-FredRichi
https://fredrichi.itch.io/

Thoughts- game looks amazing. This is my first time playing a game like this. Getting Duke Nukem and Wolfenstein vibes.
Game runs pretty well 10/10 









 Twitter: https://twitter.com/EnduringS0LDIER


 *** ABOUT THE CHANNEL ***
Working on upgrading quality so video upload rate will slow for a bit.
If you love the outro please check this link for more info on the artist :)
